fields.location: Vacuum humidity crossings in all weather cases; METHOD ground service paragraph
fields.finding: The reproduced humidity capacity and seam conversion retain 284.9 K bulk gas while weather.T_K varies. The 32.5165 Pa criterion instead derives from a fixed 274.007117 K cold-film screen.
fields.effect: The published 17.280 h result is correct under its inherited gas-temperature convention; it is not a demonstrated weather-wide operating interval.
fields.proposed_fix: Expose the bulk-gas temperature in each row and couple it to the cold-surface field before granting operational humidity/life credit. The supplied sensitivity holds rates and the cold-film target fixed; it is not a forecast.
